title: Rakhi making by special children
summary: It was a nice feeling to see the children's enthusiasm in making Rakhi and, with full smiles, enjoying Rakshabandhan with the help of their teachers.
description: It was a nice feeling to see the children's enthusiasm in making Rakhi and, with full smiles, enjoying Rakshabandhan with the help of their teachers. They loved the snacks distributed to them by Rotary Club of Bombay Juhu Beach.
